import re def grab_html_tags(html_code: str): """ Scan the provided HTML string for tags using a regular expression and return a list of all detected tags. Parameters: html_code (str): The HTML string to parse. Returns: list[str]: A list containing all tag strings found in the input. If no tags are present or an error occurs, returns an empty list. """ # Regular expression to match HTML tags (e.g.,
, , ) tag_pattern = re.compile(r'<[^>]+>', flags=re.IGNORECASE | re.DOTALL) try: # Find all non-overlapping matches of the pattern tags = tag_pattern.findall(html_code) except Exception: # In case of any unexpected error, return an empty list tags = [] return tags
